name: 02343 · Holbrook, MA
findings: ZIP 02343 (Holbrook) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02343 (Holbrook) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
